evaluation_scope: held-out passage retrieval evaluation; not answer evaluation
pdf_filename: Entrepreneurial STEM Education and Innovation Ecosystems.pdf

latency.note: Single pass after one warm-up query; descriptive, not a rigorous benchmark. Combined latency sums separately measured stages; it is not directly measured end-to-end request latency.

per_question.question: Why does the author consider an integrative literature review appropriate for this topic?
According to the PRISMA reporting template, has a live database search been completed, and how should numerical values be handled?
Which three theoretical perspectives inform the review?
Which publication years did the review prioritise, and when were earlier works retained?
What five concept clusters organised the review's search terms?
What curriculum activities does the business-principles table suggest for customer discovery and user research?
What financial-literacy assignments does the business-principles table suggest?
In university settings, what should intellectual property education be connected to?
Which responsible-innovation concerns does the regulatory and ethical discussion identify?
Why might a technically functioning innovation still fail, according to the document?
Which alternative pathways can business model thinking help STEM students compare?
What support and coordination do interdisciplinary capstone projects require?
What follow-up does the document recommend so a short innovation event can produce deeper learning?
How does the document suggest integrating business principles when STEM curricula are already overloaded?
Why are faculty incentives important for interdisciplinary teaching and entrepreneurship mentoring?
What determines whether policy frameworks translate into institutional change?
What alternative does the proposed framework suggest when a full technology transfer office is not feasible?
According to the document, how does NSF I-Corps help researchers and students examine the commercial potential of research?
Which provisions of the Nigerian Startup Act 2022 does the document highlight?
Which two infrastructure problems does the Nigeria discussion specifically link to constrained experimentation and prototyping?
What does the document caution against presenting entrepreneurship education as a simple solution to?
Which social and geographic inequalities does the document identify as affecting participation in entrepreneurial STEM opportunities in the United States?
What are the six dimensions of the framework proposed for integrating business principles into STEM education?
Which outcomes does the future-research discussion recommend examining in longitudinal studies of entrepreneurial STEM education?
What potential uses and concerns does the document identify for AI and digital tools in entrepreneurial STEM education?
